title: Collateral is cheap only if it is eligible
prompt: Deliver collateral worth at least10 USD million after haircuts. Treasury and corporate bonds are indivisible1-million face blocks; cash is in.01-million blocks. Treasury availability6, haircut2%, annual opportunity cost1% of face; corporate availability5, haircut15%, cost.4%; cash availability5, cost2.5%. Recognized corporate collateral may not exceed4 million. This finite menu is the entire feasible universe. Minimize annual cost; break ties by less cash, then fewer Treasury blocks, then fewer corporate blocks. Return bond blocks[Treasury,corporate], cash, annual cost and recognized value.
instructions: Solve the synthetic quantitative-finance question using its supplied inputs and conventions. A calculator or local code is allowed. External market data is unnecessary. Return JSON with question_id and answers, where answers maps every output name to its typed value. Numeric arrays must follow the specified order.
